inspiration.observed_pattern: An active-parent report combines an inner per-parent LATERAL LIMIT-one lookup for the latest child with a left per-parent LATERAL grouped-and-ranked lookup for the most frequent related label, preserving parents whose latest child has no related items.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a customer order digest. MariaDB-compatible windowed derived relations replace both correlated LATERAL subqueries: one ROW_NUMBER relation selects the latest order per active customer, and another independently ranks product totals per customer before a LEFT JOIN preserves an order with no items. The source schema, identifiers, rows, and commerce labels are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Active customers 601, 602, and 605 have orders; customer 603 has no order and is excluded by the inner latest-order relation; inactive customer 604 is filtered out. Customer 605 has a latest order with no items and must remain with a NULL top product.
determinism_notes: Customer IDs, active flags, order timestamps, order IDs, item quantities, product IDs, ranking tie-breakers, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE digest_customers (customer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_email VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE digest_orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, order_total DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE digest_products (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, product_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE digest_order_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT NOT NULL, product_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH latest_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, order_id, created_at, order_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC) AS latest_rank FROM digest_orders), product_totals AS (SELECT o.customer_id, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC, p.product_id ASC) AS product_rank FROM digest_orders AS o JOIN digest_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN digest_products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, p.product_id, p.product_name) SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_email, latest.order_id AS latest_order_id, latest.created_at AS latest_order_at, latest.order_total, top_product.product_name AS top_product, top_product.units AS top_product_units FROM digest_customers AS c JOIN latest_orders AS latest ON latest.customer_id = c.customer_id AND latest.latest_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN product_totals AS top_product ON top_product.customer_id = c.customer_id AND top_product.product_rank = 1 WHERE c.active = 1 ORDER BY c.customer_id

checks.sql: SELECT customer_id, active FROM digest_customers ORDER BY customer_id
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_total) AS lifetime_total FROM digest_orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
